نقتوي (form VIII)
# نَقْتَوِي (naqtawī) /naq.ta.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# نَقْتَوِيَ (naqtawiya) /naq.ta.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
